full_judgment: 6. Mr. Mozaffar Hossain, the learned Advocate appearing for the defendant petitioners, submits that the trial Court dismissed the suit as not maintainable on the ground of pre-maturity and absence of cause of action as no penal action was taken by the Governing Body in suspending the plaintiff opposite party but the learned District Judge without discarding such a plea set aside the judgment and decree without reasons and as such, the judgment of reversal passed by the learned District. Judge cannot be sustained in law. The learned Advocate further submits that the learned District. Judge also committed an error of law resulting in an error in the decision occasioning failure of justice in passing the decree in part declaring the impugad memo as to be illegal while observing that the Governing Body committed no illegality in taking the resolution dated 1-7-90. He also submits that the impugned order of suspension pending enquiry cannot be challenged as it does not give rise to any cause of action and the suit being hit by provisions of section 42 of the Specific Relief Act as no consequential prayer was made and the court below failed to give any finding although issues on these points were framed. The learned Advocate finally submits that the impugned resolution and the memo are free from procedural defect as it provides provision for formation of enquiry committee for enquiry and taking action.
